description: code generators (§19, M2.9): Prisma (`prisma generate`, default client output in node_modules/.prisma/client and node_modules/@prisma/client) and graphql-codegen (codegen.yml: schema, documents, a gitignored src/gql/graphql.js), run from package scripts. The generated files are vendored stand-ins; the oracle never runs generators, so tests affected through generator inputs are declared with expect_affected.

mutations.name: prisma-schema
mutations.description: add a field to the Prisma schema; db.test loads the generated client

mutations.name: prisma-config-added
mutations.description: add a prisma.config.ts (a probe of `prisma generate`) that moves the schema

ops.content:
import { defineConfig } from 'prisma/config';

export default defineConfig({ schema: 'db/schema.prisma' });

mutations.name: graphql-schema
mutations.description: edit the GraphQL schema read by graphql-codegen

mutations.name: graphql-document
mutations.description: edit a document matched by codegen.yml `documents`

mutations.name: graphql-document-added
mutations.description: add a document matching the `documents` glob

mutations.name: edit-other
mutations.description: control: edit a module only other.test loads
